Title: contact form must not accept an empty name, subject and message
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Steps:
1. Open /contact_us.
2. Enter only an e-mail; leave name, subject and message empty.
3. Click "Submit" and accept the dialog.
Expected Result: CORRECT behaviour: the form should reject empty name/subject/message. Actual: it is accepted (known defect DEF-02, marked test.fail).

Title: quantity 0 must not be accepted into the cart
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Steps:
1. Open /product_details/1.
2. Set the quantity to 0 (or -3).
3. Click "Add to cart" and open the cart.
Expected Result: CORRECT behaviour: quantities below 1 must be rejected. Actual: the line is added (known defect DEF-03, marked test.fail).
